findings.description: The shipped Experiment 3 script ran after a path-only adjustment, but four reported AICs (C1, C3, C4, C5) did not recur.
findings.evidence: E3_analysis_run1.log prints AIC 1766.298 for proportion-opinion, and the model-selection table gives single-predictor AICs 463.1 (Bayes), 569.8 (UPCO), and 785.1 (Competence). Reported values are 1722, 410, 497, and 507, respectively.
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the manuscript’s comparison values and model labels with the shipped Experiment 3 script and its reported model specifications; publish the exact analysis calls used for those values.

findings.description: The script contains a placeholder working-directory command that must be disabled to run against the linked OSF data.
findings.evidence: The original E3_analysis.R line setwd(r"(YOUR DIRECTORY HERE)") is not a usable path. The executed copy comments out only that line.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a project-relative data path or document the required working directory.

limitations: The OSF data file was downloaded to a temporary location outside the certification bundle and was not copied into the deliverable.

The single-predictor results C3–C5 are taken from the shipped OLS model-selection table; the script does not contain separate mixed-effects calls for Bayes, UPCO, and Competence comparable to the two explicit mixed-effects calls used for C1 and C2.
No assessment of scientific correctness or robustness was performed.
